data.name: Faatimah
data.gender_notes: Faatimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Faatimah is the name of the daughter of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and Khadija (RA). She is known for her piety and dedication to Islam. The name Faatimah is derived from the Arabic word faatimah which means 'giver' or 'provider'. This name is a reminder of the blessings that Allah (SWT) provides to us. The name Faatimah carries the meaning “Daughter of Fatima” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faatimah usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of fatima and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of devotion and commitment to Islam.
data.etymology: Faatimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Daughter of Fatima.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faatimah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
